entities.summary: Albert William Lee is an English guitarist known for his fingerstyle and hybrid picking technique. Lee has worked, both in the studio and on tour, with many famous musicians from a wide range of genres. He has also maintained a solo career and is a noted composer and musical director. Albert Lee was a composers & musicians from Leominster (b. 1943-12-21, Leominster). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
